items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Will Davis played better than me, so I watched them.

ctx.x: And who – who affected you? Who were some of the older musicians who affected you and changed your life?
Don’t ask me – oh, oh there were some. Okay, we got to say – Tommy Flannigan played better. Terry Pollard played better, Will Davis played better than me, so I watched them.
